effects.label: Brightness pulse
effects.description: Cyclically brightens the existing color around a point.

effects.label: Flicker
effects.description: Irregularly animates an existing light source.

effects.label: Shimmer
effects.description: Moves a band that amplifies the existing color.

effects.label: Light sweep
effects.description: Moves a band of optional emission through a region.

effects.label: Ray fan
effects.description: Builds a noisy field of rays emitted from a point.

effects.label: Glitter
effects.description: Places periodically twinkling points.

effects.label: Caustics
effects.description: Creates a moving network of cellular light bands.

effects.label: Sway
effects.description: Bends region content with a wave-like motion.

effects.label: Ripple
effects.description: Propagates a wave from the selected point.

effects.label: Surface ripple
effects.description: Distorts a region with two directional waves.

effects.label: Vector warp
effects.description: Warps the image through a procedural direction field.

effects.label: Water flow
effects.description: Advects the image through a flow field and crossfades loop phases.

effects.label: Parallax
effects.description: Offsets image layers using automatic depth or a project depth map.

effects.label: Heat haze
effects.description: Adds a subtle, undulating distortion.

effects.label: Spin
effects.description: Rotates the contents of a disc around a point.

effects.label: Twirl
effects.description: Twists the image increasingly toward the edge of a disc.

effects.label: Drift
effects.description: Moves the entire image back and forth along a selected direction.

effects.label: Shake
effects.description: Adds closed-loop irregular shake.

effects.label: Chromatic aberration
effects.description: Separates RGB channels across the full image around an adjustable optical center.

effects.label: Film grain
effects.description: Applies deterministic luminance noise.

effects.label: Tape tracking
effects.description: Combines tracking, gated artifacts, noise, and RGB separation.

effects.label: Energy veins
effects.description: Overlays moving blue-white energy veins with a brightening blend.

effects.label: Clouds
effects.description: Blends a procedural cloud field with the image.

effects.label: Fog
effects.description: Adds a broad, soft atmospheric layer.

effects.label: Flame field
effects.description: Distorts and illuminates a region like a flame.

effects.label: Fluid
effects.description: Simulates dye and flow emitted from a selected point.

effects.label: Smoke
effects.description: Emits growing soft smoke particles.

effects.label: Fire
effects.description: Emits warm flame particles.

effects.label: Energy shell
effects.description: Creates an irregular glowing shell.

effects.label: Stars
effects.description: Places twinkling points throughout a region.

effects.label: Shooting stars
effects.description: Moves long luminous trails through a region.

effects.label: Dust
effects.description: Moves fine particles through a region.

effects.label: Embers
effects.description: Emits small hot particles from a point.

effects.label: Sparks
effects.description: Emits directional sparks with trails.

effects.label: Rain
effects.description: Moves dense directional streaks.

effects.label: Snow
effects.description: Moves soft flakes with lateral sway.

effects.label: Particle burst
effects.description: Scatters sparks radially from a point.

effects.label: Discharge
effects.description: Creates radial branching impulses around a point.

effects.label: Electric arc
effects.description: Connects two points with branching lightning.

effects.label: Local shift
effects.description: Softly offsets a selected disc of the image.

effects.label: Oscillating shift
effects.description: Moves a region back and forth along a closed path.

effects.label: Swing
effects.description: Bends a band extending from a point along a selected axis.

effects.label: Directional waves
effects.description: Offsets samples perpendicular to the wave direction.

effects.label: Blur
effects.description: Blurs a region with a compact sampling kernel.

effects.label: Precise blur
effects.description: Blurs a region with a denser kernel.

effects.label: Radial blur
effects.description: Blurs the image along rays from a point.

effects.label: Motion blur
effects.description: Spatially blurs a single frame in a selected direction.

effects.label: Color multiply
effects.description: Periodically multiplies a region by one color.

effects.label: Gradient blend
effects.description: Blends a region with a directional gradient.

effects.label: Color key
effects.description: Reduces the alpha of pixels similar to a selected color.

effects.label: Opacity
effects.description: Periodically reduces alpha within a region.

effects.label: Reflection
effects.description: Blends a region with its reflected variant.

effects.label: Tint
effects.description: Gently colors a region while preserving luminance.

effects.label: Fisheye
effects.description: Non-linearly scales the image around a point.

effects.label: Perspective
effects.description: Projects a region using perspective division.

effects.label: Refraction
effects.description: Distorts the image through a procedural normal field.

effects.label: Skew
effects.description: Offsets rows proportionally to their height.

effects.label: Region shift
effects.description: Periodically shifts a region in a selected direction.

effects.label: Edge detection
effects.description: Emphasizes image gradients.

effects.label: Edge glow
effects.description: Derives an original directional glow from image edges.

effects.label: Star glare
effects.description: Casts multi-directional streaks from bright image areas.

effects.label: Local contrast
effects.description: Enhances local contrast like a simple unsharp mask.

effects.label: Radial source rays
effects.description: Emits luminance-guided rays toward a selected source point.

effects.label: Directional source rays
effects.description: Extracts bright source pixels into broad rays along one direction.

effects.label: Lens flare
effects.description: Adds a source glow, chromatic lens ghosts, and an anamorphic streak.

effects.label: HUD ring
effects.description: Draws a rotating segmented HUD ring around a selected point.

effects.label: HUD cog
effects.description: Draws a rotating procedural gear around a selected point.

effects.label: Radial ticks
effects.description: Rotates sparse deterministic tick marks around a selected point.

effects.label: Orbit markers
effects.description: Animates irregular procedural HUD markers around a selected point.

effects.label: Rain on glass
effects.description: Refracts and frosts the image through moving drops and wet trails.

effects.label: Constellation
effects.description: Connects drifting deterministic points into a changing luminous network.

effects.label: Bokeh
effects.description: Blurs through a spiral aperture while retaining bright lens discs.

effects.label: Signal breakup
effects.description: Tears image space through moving faults, interlace, noise, and RGB separation.

effects.label: Star trails
effects.description: Orbits luminous stars on concentric lanes with fading curved trails.

effects.label: Bloom
effects.description: Extracts bright pixels and spreads them through a broad multiscale glow.

effects.label: Masked lighting
effects.description: Adds colored light using a light mask and an unlit image.

effects.label: Depth fog
effects.description: Uses a project depth map to place noisy fog behind and between image features.

effects.label: Volumetric clouds
effects.description: Ray-marches a lit procedural cloud volume over the image.

effects.label: Light pillar
effects.description: Ray-marches one rotating, four-octave deformed axial light field.

effects.label: Spotlight
effects.description: Darkens the complete image and restores albedo inside a soft procedural or managed shape.

effects.label: Image ribbon
effects.description: Deforms a managed transparent image before compositing it as an independent moving layer.

effects.label: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Folds the source into rotating mirrored angular sectors.

effects.label: Iridescence
effects.description: Modulates source colors with a flowing silk-like interference field.

effects.label: Lens iris
effects.description: Opens and closes overlapping procedural aperture blades.

effects.label: Grid scan
effects.description: Projects a perspective room grid with a moving luminous scan band.

effects.label: Radial beams
effects.description: Rotates regular gradient-colored sunbeams around a selected point.

effects.label: Topographic contours
effects.description: Overlays animated contour lines derived from a procedural height field.

effects.label: Dithering
effects.description: Pixelates and reduces colors through an explicit ordered or noise threshold raster.

effects.label: Halftone
effects.description: Rebuilds image tone from sampled dots on square or hexagonal color-separation grids.

effects.label: Sprite morph
effects.description: Morphs an ordered chain of sprite sources with automatic shape, particle, or growth transitions.

effects.label: Sprite layer
effects.description: Places one animated or fixed sprite directly in the composition.

effects.label: Sprite particles
effects.description: Emits deterministic moving instances from one sprite image or sprite sheet.

effects.label: Fluid lens
effects.description: Turns a rounded region into a magnifying, refracting, frosted lens with a moving liquid surface.

effects.label: ASCII art
effects.description: Overlays a built-in ordered character style derived from image luminance.

effects.label: Projective transform
effects.description: Projects a region as a rotatable 3D plane with optional cylindrical bend.

effects.label: Image transition
effects.description: Moves a deterministic threshold field between the current and target images.

effects.label: Color remap
effects.description: Selectively replaces one color or maps a two-anchor color range while preserving texture.

effects.label: Posterize
effects.description: Reduces saturated source channels to a small explicit set of color levels.

effects.label: Painterly smoothing
effects.description: Uses a Kuwahara filter to create painterly flat regions while preserving edges.

effects.label: Tiling array
effects.description: Repeats a current-image crop or project tile image along a closed path.

effects.label: Tone mapping
effects.description: Compresses or reshapes luminance through one of eleven explicit tone curves.

effects.label: Color grading
effects.description: Combines neutral base corrections in a fixed, documented processing order.

effects.label: Layer reveal
effects.description: Moves a soft window that reveals a managed auxiliary image.

effects.label: X-ray scan
effects.description: Moves an original band of inverted or tinted imagery.

effects.label: Bubbles
effects.description: Moves translucent bubbles with highlights.

effects.label: Swarm
effects.description: Moves oscillating particles through a region.

effects.label: Path trail
effects.description: Guides particles between two points.

effects.label: Droplets
effects.description: Moves cool droplets with bright highlights.

effects.label: Leaves
effects.description: Moves rotating leaf-like strokes.

effects.label: Particle vortex
effects.description: Guides particles along a contracting spiral.

effects.label: Glyphs
effects.description: Animates procedural runes built from rings, polygons, swirls, and glow.

effects.label: DNA helix
effects.description: Builds a rotating helix from points.

effects.label: Pixel grid
effects.description: Reduces a region to stable blocks sampled from the source.

effects.label: Analog display
effects.description: Adds scanlines, raster noise, flicker, and display-edge shading.

effects.label: Hex field
effects.description: Draws a field of filled hexagonal cells with a traveling activation pulse.

effects.label: Color LUT
effects.description: Maps source colors through a regular two-dimensional cube LUT.

effects.label: Vignette
effects.description: Shades the boundary of a region with a controllable rounded profile.

effects.label: Drop shadow
effects.description: Builds a soft offset shadow from transparent pixels in the current image.

effects.label: Lens warp
effects.description: Applies first- and second-order radial lens distortion around a point.

effects.label: Noise field
effects.description: Creates a periodic tinted noise field with optional source displacement.

effects.label: Flow blur
effects.description: Blurs each pixel along a direction encoded by a flow-map image.

effects.label: Waveform
effects.description: Draws a glowing procedural waveform across a selected region.

effects.label: Pixel sorting
effects.description: Sorts contiguous luminance-selected spans along a chosen image axis.
